verdict.rationale: PostHog AI is documented as an in-product analyst in a chat sidebar and inline entry points. Beyond answering questions, it creates dashboards, surveys, alerts and feature flags, edits UI filters, and starts coding tasks that end in PRs; the same agent is reachable from Slack and Desktop. One hands-on user report says the assistant refused to build a SQL-based cohort and slowed the UI badly, which shows real limits but does not contradict the documented capabilities. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation that delegated tasks work reliably, and evidence on performance and coverage gaps such as cohort creation.
